title: Presentation Template (Demo)
abstract: A reusable HTML deck template aligned with the alhaol.github.io cyber theme. Demonstrates every slide variant: cover, section divider, two-column, quote, code, mermaid diagram, image, video, PDF embed, table, and closing.

title: The Efficiency Trilemma
abstract: A framework for selecting small language models across three axes — correctness, computation, consumption — grounded in the SLM-Bench (EMNLP 2025) benchmark of 15 models on 4 hardware configurations.

title: Scaling AI vs. Scaling Judgment
abstract: Universities are scaling AI faster than they are scaling the judgment-formation their degrees were created to certify. Keynote on the augmentation trap, the cognitive-offloading evidence (Gerlich, Sourati, Lodge & Loble), the quieter research-integrity crisis, and a five-question audit for the next vendor contract.

title: Designing for Effort
abstract: Assessment redesign in the AI era — three substitution-neutral patterns (3-minute viva, process portfolios, in-class synthesis) plus a rubric retrofit that shifts weight from polish to reasoning. Grounded in Bastani PNAS 2025, Kofinas BJET 2025, and the University of Sydney two-lane framework.

title: The Mission-Based Adoption Playbook
abstract: Five moves that turn AI procurement into compounding institutional advantage — pre-AI baselines, faculty development before deployment, four real contract clauses, three equity audits, and an 18-month outcome-monitoring loop. The constructive companion to The Augmentation Trap.

title: AI for Learning Engineering
abstract: What 2025–26 evidence actually shows works — four design principles (intentional purpose, cognitive-load instrumentation, formative feedback over completion, durability evaluation), a loop reference architecture (state estimator → policy → spaced scheduler → delayed probe), and the evaluation harness most teams skip. Grounded in Kestin 2025, Bastani PNAS 2025, LearnLM, and OECD 2026.
